entries.speaker: Young Officer
entries.en: ...Man, that was a weird mission. I didn't[n]think we'd get intel on exactly where the[n]thief would be.
entries.uk: ...Ох, оце було дивне завдання. Не думав,[n]що нам повідомлять, де саме[n]буде злодій.

entries.speaker: Officer with Good Posture
entries.en: I've never seen anything quite like it[n]myself.
entries.uk: Я й сам ніколи такого[n]не бачив.

entries.speaker: Officer with Good Posture
entries.en: Having us split up into two thin[n]squadrons, take one designated path,[n]get into position, then wait?
entries.uk: Розділити нас на два невеликі[n]загони, піти одним указаним шляхом,[n]зайняти позиції й чекати?

entries.speaker: Officer with Good Posture
entries.en: Pretty bizarre, if you ask me.

entries.speaker: Young Officer
entries.en: And that casino too... Do you think it was[n]some kind of illusion?
entries.uk: А ще те казино... Думаєте, це була[n]якась ілюзія?

entries.speaker: Officer with Good Posture
entries.en: Keep your voice down. We're not[n]supposed to be discussing this.
